location: Outside Government House, Bangkok; overnight camp on Nakhon Pathom Road, with Jan4 action at Gate2 and Jan5 action near Prince Chumphon statue
summary: The Standard reports the “Do Not Beg” group’s Government House overnight camp began Dec24, 2020; PostToday and the Dec20–31 Mob Data report place its activity there by Dec29. The camp continued through separate Jan4 and Jan5 actions: two sign-holders were arrested on Jan4 and police read an order to end the overnight camp that evening; on Jan5 police arrested group members and removed the tent/belongings. Exact turnout and final physical end remain unknown.
notes: The Standard directly dates the camp since Dec24, 2020, which places this continuous episode in Thailand-2020-12. “Thailand-2020-12” is the coordinator reconciliation-buffer owner label; coordinator confirmation remains pending and no older-month unit is created. E003 is preserved here with its full prior January candidate fields/evidence and the separately dated Jan4 and Jan5 actions/responses. PostToday and Mob Data confirm activity by Dec29 but do not set onset. The Dec29 police encounter is outside the Jan4/Jan5 response fields.

jan4_action.summary: TLHR reports two group members held a New Year sign and were arrested; after release Boon returned to the camp. TLHR separately reports police read an order at about 18:20 requiring the overnight encampment to end, but the group continued.

arrests.summary: TLHR and The Standard report Boon/two members arrested Jan4 after sign-holding; The Standard gives no full crowd count.

beatings.summary: TLHR reports an injury allegation contradicted by the police record; The Standard does not state a beating.

crowd_dispersal.summary: TLHR says police read an order requiring the overnight camp to end around 18:20; group continued.

jan5_action.location: Near the Prince Chumphon statue, Government House, Bangkok
jan5_action.summary: At around 06:00 TLHR reports police arrested four group members and removed the tent; The Standard reports police requested belongings be removed and took Boon/group members and belongings to Nang Loeng police station without giving a number. Neither source establishes complete camp departure or final physical end.

arrests.summary: TLHR reports four Jan5 arrests; The Standard says Boon and group members were taken but does not count them.

beatings.summary: Neither source clearly reports a beating on Jan5.

crowd_dispersal.summary: TLHR reports tent removal; The Standard reports belongings removed following police intervention. Complete clearing is not established.

preserved_january_candidate_record.title: “Do Not Beg” Social Security encampment near Government House (possible late-2020 onset)
preserved_january_candidate_record.location: Near Government House, Bangkok; Jan 4 at Gate 2 and Jan 5 near the Prince Chumphon statue
preserved_january_candidate_record.scope: TLHR reports group members camped near Government House from late 2020 while seeking the prime minister’s attention to Social Security law changes concerning early use of old-age contributions. On Jan 4 two members held a New Year sign and were arrested; after release they returned to camp. Police read an order to end the overnight gathering that evening. On Jan 5 police arrested four members and dismantled the tent. Exact physical onset month and final end are unknown.
preserved_january_candidate_record.organizer: “Do Not Beg” group, as named by TLHR; no separate new January organizer is identified.
preserved_january_candidate_record.threshold_50_evidence: Not established. TLHR reports two arrests on Jan 4 and four on Jan 5, but arrest totals do not establish gathering size; no headcount or qualitative 50+ estimate is given.

country.summary: TLHR identifies Thailand and Government House in Bangkok; provisional code comes from assignment.

unit_month.summary: The encampment continued into Jan 4-5, 2021, but TLHR says it began in late 2020; this unit-month does not establish ownership.

start_date.summary: The Standard states the group had camped overnight outside Government House since Dec24, 2020; the physical episode began outside January. Keep E003 as a continuation mapping, not a January-start event.

start_precision.summary: The Standard gives Dec24, 2020 as the reported camp start date; the assigned January unit records only continuation actions.

end_date.summary: The tent was removed and belongings taken on Jan5, but no source states that all participants left or the continuous camp ended; physical end remains unknown.

location.summary: The Standard locates the overnight camp outside Government House since Dec24; PostToday specifies Nakhon Pathom Road by Dec29; TLHR gives Jan4 Gate2 and Jan5 Prince Chumphon statue.

scope.summary: The Standard reports the camp began Dec24 and sought access to Social Security old-age contributions; TLHR reports Jan4 sign/arrests and Jan5 arrest/tent removal within the continuing camp.

organizer.summary: The Standard identifies the “Do Not Beg” group led by Dr Boon; TLHR attributes the Jan4/5 actions to the same group.

demands.summary: The group sought use of Social Security old-age contributions before retirement; The Standard and TLHR both describe this domestic policy demand.

participants_original.summary: The reports identify two Jan4 and four Jan5 arrestees, not the total number present.

participants_min.summary: No valid turnout lower bound; arrest counts are not turnout.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance count or qualitative 50+ estimate; threshold unknown.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is established; the sources describe sign-holding, sitting and camping.

state_response.accommodation.summary: No actual hearing or reception of the demand is reported.

state_response.arrests.summary: TLHR reports two Jan4 arrests and four Jan5 arrests; The Standard independently confirms Boon’s Jan4 arrest and Jan5 removal of Boon and group members but gives no count. Keep Jan4/5 actions separate; no total crowd size follows from arrests.

state_response.beatings.summary: TLHR reports an injury allegation contested by the police account; The Standard describes struggle/resistance but no explicit beating. Beating remains unknown.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: TLHR reports a Jan4 order to end the overnight camp; on Jan5, TLHR reports a tent removal and The Standard reports police directing removal of belongings. These are attempted dispersal actions, not proof that all people departed.

state_response.ignore.summary: No explicit refusal/avoidance by the prime minister or another official is established; lack of a reported meeting is not enough.

state_response.killings.summary: No event-linked death is reported; absence is not established.

state_response.shootings.summary: No firearm shooting is reported; absence is not established.

preserved_january_candidate_record.notes: Do not treat Jan 4 as the confirmed onset: TLHR reports camping since late 2020. Preserve E003 as a pending-unit record with null physical start; continuation card C001 records a possible 2020 onset with month unresolved. The Jan4/5 arrests and attempted order refer to the ongoing camp, not independent events. Arrest counts do not establish >=50 turnout. TLHR’s injury account is contested against the police record and does not specify a beating. PostToday S038 independently confirms the encampment was present by Dec29, 2020, but not its actual onset; its Dec29 police interaction is not assigned as a Jan4/5 response. The Standard S048 independently reports the camp began Dec24, 2020. This changes the physical ownership: preserve E003 under C001 as a Dec2020-origin continuation, with Jan4/5 actions retained there; do not create a new January event or transfer Dec29 responses into January.
